note: Data-driven copy candidates. Trigger thresholds are illustrative and must be validated using actual Songsta stats per replay period. Make the pick stable by period + ID; never imply personal facts without data.

rules.privacy: Only local listening history and existing library metadata. No invented statistics.
rules.noJudgment: Avoid criticism of low activity or repeated listening.
